_comment: Generated by `go run ./tools/override-gen` from internal/live/override's registry.
Do not edit. GitHub issue #2309: every provider behaviour override, the upstream
issue it stands in for, and the provider version its proof ran against.

overrides.name: aws-alb-target-group-replace-in-use
overrides.summary: Replacing a target group that keeps its name deletes it first, which fails with ResourceInUse while a listener or rule forwards to it
overrides.stock_alternative: Stock OpenTofu reports the same problem only after the apply has failed. name_prefix with create_before_destroy avoids it; the warning names that before apply.

overrides.name: aws-amplify-app-custom-headers
overrides.summary: custom_headers written as YAML plans an update on every plan, because AWS returns the same headers as JSON without the customHeaders root key
overrides.stock_alternative: None: AWS rejects the form it returns (no customHeaders root key), so no configuration matches what is read back.

overrides.name: aws-appconfig-hosted-configuration-version-flag-timestamps
overrides.summary: The _createdAt and _updatedAt keys AppConfig adds to feature-flag content replace an unchanged version on every plan
overrides.stock_alternative: Stock OpenTofu offers only lifecycle { ignore_changes = [content] }, which also hides every real content change.

overrides.name: aws-backup-region-settings-subset
overrides.summary: Configuring some resource types in resource_type_opt_in_preference or resource_type_management_preference plans every other type AWS returns as removed on every plan
overrides.stock_alternative: Listing every resource type AWS returns stops the diff in stock OpenTofu until AWS adds a type, as it did with DSQL; the configuration then drifts again.

overrides.name: aws-elasticache-user-no-password
overrides.summary: authentication_mode type "no-password-required" plans an update to "no-password" on every plan
overrides.stock_alternative: None: the provider rejects no-password, the value AWS returns, in configuration, so stock users can only ignore_changes the whole authentication_mode block.

overrides.name: aws-lb-target-group-replace-in-use
overrides.summary: Replacing a target group that keeps its name deletes it first, which fails with ResourceInUse while a listener or rule forwards to it
overrides.stock_alternative: Stock OpenTofu reports the same problem only after the apply has failed. name_prefix with create_before_destroy avoids it; the warning names that before apply.

overrides.name: aws-rds-cluster-destroy-from-config
overrides.summary: Destroy ignores skip_final_snapshot and final_snapshot_identifier as configured, using the values last applied
overrides.stock_alternative: Applying the flag before destroying works in stock OpenTofu, as two runs. OpenTofu treats destroy as state-only by design and calls the real fix a protocol-level destroy-time argument (opentofu/opentofu#3472, blocked).

overrides.name: aws-route-table-route-empty-strings
overrides.summary: Changing one inline route lists every route removed and re-added, because unset route fields are null in configuration and "" in state
overrides.stock_alternative: Declaring routes as separate aws_route resources avoids the churn in stock OpenTofu, at the cost of restructuring the configuration; inline routes are common in modules users do not own.

overrides.name: aws-security-group-rule-cidr-order
overrides.summary: Reordering the same CIDRs in cidr_blocks or ipv6_cidr_blocks replaces the rule
overrides.stock_alternative: Wrapping a list you write in sort() keeps its order stable in stock OpenTofu, and aws_vpc_security_group_ingress_rule takes one CIDR per rule. Neither helps when the list comes from a module or data source whose order changes, which is where the replace bites.

overrides.name: aws-service-discovery-service-failure-threshold
overrides.summary: A configured health_check_custom_config failure_threshold other than 1 replaces the service on every plan
overrides.stock_alternative: Setting failure_threshold = 1 stops the replacement in stock OpenTofu, and the provider's deprecation warning says AWS always stores 1. The override only saves editing that one argument.
